# Flecha

> Flecha is a free, open-source (MIT) Chromium browser for macOS built for developers: a vertical sidebar with Spaces, a command bar that understands developer shortcuts, and an MCP server that lets coding agents like Claude Code and Cursor see and drive your tabs. No account, no telemetry; everything stays on your Mac.

Key facts:

- Platform: macOS 13 Ventura or newer, on Apple silicon (M1 or newer) and Intel. One of the few Arc-style browsers with a build for Intel Macs. Windows and Linux builds are not available yet.
- Engine: a Chromium fork with a small patch set. Pages render as in Chrome, Google sign-in works and Chrome Web Store extensions install.
- Browser features: Spaces with their own cookies and logins (on by default for new Spaces), pinned tabs, folders with emoji icons, favorites, Today tabs that archive themselves and a searchable archive, multi-select tabs, Peek, split view, Flechinha (Flecha's take on Little Arc), Air Traffic Control for links from other apps, Stay On Top, automatic picture-in-picture, and its own Spaces, Tabs and Archive menus in the Mac menu bar.
- Streaming: Flecha doesn't include Widevine DRM, because Google only licenses it to browsers that go through a paid certification and Flecha has no paid parts. Netflix, Disney+, Prime Video, Max, Hulu, Apple TV+, Spotify's web player and similar services don't play; Flecha offers to open those pages in Safari. YouTube, X, Twitch and H.264/AAC video play normally.
- Privacy: the app has no account, no usage analytics and no crash reports. It only contacts flecha.dev for update checks (Sparkle). Ad and tracker blocking (EasyList and EasyPrivacy) is built in and on by default.
- Switching from Arc: the welcome tour imports Arc's Spaces (with their colours and icons; other Arc profiles become Spaces with their own logins), pinned tabs with folders, favorites and history, and bookmarks and history from Chrome, Brave, Edge, Vivaldi, Opera, Firefox and Safari. Importing and the MCP server need a helper registered once with `chromium/scripts/install-native-host.sh`.
- Made by OPrimoDev. Not affiliated with The Browser Company or Google.

## Docs

- [Install Flecha](https://flecha.dev/docs/install/): download, updates, default browser, the helper for importing and agents
- [Arc is shutting down: what to do before December 22](https://flecha.dev/docs/arc-shutdown/): Arc's shutdown timeline, what you lose, a checklist of what to export or save, and how to choose a replacement
- [Switch from Arc](https://flecha.dev/docs/switch-from-arc/): what's imported, where each Arc feature lives in Flecha, Arc-to-Flecha shortcuts, import troubleshooting and a first-day checklist
- [Command bar](https://flecha.dev/docs/command-bar/): `gh`, `npm`, `mdn`, `caniuse`, `so`, `env`, `boost`, JWT and Unix timestamp decoding
- [The MCP server for coding agents](https://flecha.dev/docs/agents/mcp/): how to turn it on, security model and every tool (list_tabs, open_tab, activate_tab, close_tab, navigate, read_page, screenshot, console_logs, click, type, press_key, evaluate, wait_for)
- [Connect Claude Code](https://flecha.dev/docs/agents/claude-code/): `claude mcp add --transport http flecha http://127.0.0.1:7390/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer <token>"`
- [Connect Cursor or Windsurf](https://flecha.dev/docs/agents/cursor/): the `mcpServers` JSON config
- [Keyboard shortcuts](https://flecha.dev/docs/shortcuts/): every default shortcut and how to record your own
- [Tabs and the sidebar](https://flecha.dev/docs/guides/tabs/), [Spaces and separate logins](https://flecha.dev/docs/guides/spaces/), [Peek, split view and Flechinha](https://flecha.dev/docs/guides/peek-split-flechinha/)
- [Developer tools](https://flecha.dev/docs/guides/developer-tools/): environments (local/staging/prod), responsive phone view, local dev servers, console error badges
- [Boosts](https://flecha.dev/docs/guides/boosts/): per-site TypeScript and CSS
- [Privacy and ad blocking](https://flecha.dev/docs/guides/privacy/): every connection the app makes
- [What's new](https://flecha.dev/changelog/): what changed in each release
- [How Flecha is built](https://flecha.dev/docs/development/architecture/), [build from source](https://flecha.dev/docs/development/build/), [releases](https://flecha.dev/docs/development/release/)

## Compare

Arc stops working on macOS and Windows on December 22, 2026 (announced by The Browser Company on October 22, 2026, when new Arc accounts closed). Arc accounts are deactivated that day and their personal data is deleted within 30 days. Source: https://arc.net/

- [The best Arc alternatives in 2026](https://flecha.dev/docs/compare/arc-alternatives/): Flecha, Dia, Zen, Vivaldi, Brave, Edge, Chrome, Orion, Helium, Comet
- [Flecha vs Arc](https://flecha.dev/docs/compare/flecha-vs-arc/), [Flecha vs Dia](https://flecha.dev/docs/compare/flecha-vs-dia/), [Flecha vs Zen](https://flecha.dev/docs/compare/flecha-vs-zen/), [Flecha vs Vivaldi](https://flecha.dev/docs/compare/flecha-vs-vivaldi/), [Flecha vs Brave](https://flecha.dev/docs/compare/flecha-vs-brave/), [Flecha vs Orion](https://flecha.dev/docs/compare/flecha-vs-orion/), [Flecha vs Edge](https://flecha.dev/docs/compare/flecha-vs-edge/), [Flecha vs Helium](https://flecha.dev/docs/compare/flecha-vs-helium/), [Flecha vs Chrome](https://flecha.dev/docs/compare/flecha-vs-chrome/)

## Português (pt-BR)

O Flecha é um navegador Chromium gratuito e open source (MIT) para macOS, feito para devs. Ele tem sidebar vertical com Spaces, uma barra de comandos com atalhos de desenvolvedor e um servidor MCP para agentes de código como Claude Code e Cursor. Não pede conta, não tem telemetria e tudo fica no seu Mac. Roda no macOS 13 ou mais novo, em Macs com Apple silicon e Intel, e importa Spaces, abas e histórico do Arc. Não inclui o DRM Widevine, então Netflix, Disney+, o player web do Spotify e serviços parecidos não tocam nele; o Flecha oferece abrir essas páginas no Safari.

- [Página inicial em português](https://flecha.dev/pt-br/)
- [Documentação em português](https://flecha.dev/docs/pt-br/)
- [O Arc vai acabar: o que fazer antes de 22 de dezembro](https://flecha.dev/docs/pt-br/arc-shutdown/)
- [Migrar do Arc](https://flecha.dev/docs/pt-br/switch-from-arc/)
- [Alternativas ao Arc em 2026](https://flecha.dev/docs/pt-br/compare/arc-alternatives/)
- [Política de privacidade](https://flecha.dev/pt-br/privacidade/)
